integrity: The displayed joint generating function, moments, stopping law, strong law and central limit theorem have a self-contained probability-theoretic proof; exact finite computations are consistency checks, not proofs of the infinite quantifiers.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns homogeneous fixed-p Bernoulli edge retention on a uniformly grown recursive tree. It does not cover time-decaying edges, arbitrary attachment kernels or a varying p_n regime. The proof uses the standard stable martingale central limit theorem. Historical priority has not been independently certified.
title: Exact frontier law and Gaussian fluctuations for percolated recursive trees
